record.title: Evaluate the baseline and propose the next bounded task set
record.intent: Select an evidence-backed next experiment without automatically authorizing implementation beyond this gate.
requirements: Distinguish runtime compatibility, APK admission, application startup, and hardware dependencies.
Evaluate negative outcomes without converting them into successful boot, launch, or hardware claims.
Do not admit or execute the proposed successor tasks as part of this task.
acceptance: Review both baseline runs, their input identity, evidence quality and repeatability.
State confirmed findings, unresolved questions, candidate responses and the reason for the selected response.
Propose a small bounded successor task set with explicit prerequisites and acceptance criteria.
State the authorization boundary and whether evidence is sufficient to begin the proposed experiment.
